en: The postcard shows the richly decorated apse of a cathedral, with a large fresco of Christ in Judgment seated on a throne, surrounded by saints and angels in a golden semi-dome. The reverse side includes multilingual descriptions (Hungarian, German, English, Russian) identifying the scene as the sanctuary apse of the Pécs Cathedral and crediting the fresco to K. Andreas. It has standard postcard layout with address lines and stamp box.
